title: Writing at the piano
summary: He writes at the piano because of his trumpet background.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: One thing I didn't ask you, do you write at the piano or away from it?
Mostly at it. I try away, but I never--piano is a crutch for me. That comes from being a trumpet
I've known guys who sit in the back of a bus and write a piece and I marvel at that, but I can't do it.

Don't be in any more awe of that than you should be of people (inaudible). It's something that some people have and some very often have been trained. It doesn't mean that you don't write better pieces; not at all. Sometimes it's the convenience that's taken for granted, they don't work hard enough. Some people should work hard (inaudible). It comes too easy for them.
Maybe they'll learn a little bit about themselves in the process.
Certainly Stravinsky and Bartok and you name them, have done this for me and I don't know any of
them. What has been important is what their music has done to me. To me; not for me.
